'''Sona Fey'lya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the owner of the ''[[Blue Flare]]'', which she lost to [[Logron]], a criminal living near [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a town on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She later was able to steal it with the help of the Pero brothers and an adventurer.<ref name="EE" />
